blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Lightweight medical image segmentation demands both accurate boundary delineation and efficient inference, posing a fundamental challenge for models deployed in resource-constrained clinical environments. In this paper, we propose GAD-MambaUNet, an asymmetric local–global segmentation network that combines lightweight convolutional modeling with efficient state-space contextual aggregation. Our architecture employs lightweight convolutional blocks in shallow stages to perceive local features, and introduces Direction-Group Graph Selective Scan (DG-GSS) blocks in deeper stages for efficient long-range modeling. Within each DG-GSS block, direction–group feature responses are treated as graph nodes, and structured message passing is performed prior to multi-directional fusion, enabling cross-direction and cross-subspace information interaction. To further enhance semantic representation without increasing inference cost, we incorporate a frozen pretrained DINOv3 model as a semantic teacher during training only, transferring its semantic priors to the compact student network via Gradient-Adaptive Distillation. Extensive experiments on multiple public medical image segmentation benchmarks demonstrate that GAD-MambaUNet achieves superior segmentation accuracy with favorable inference efficiency.
blocks.zh: 轻量级医疗图像分解要求准确划定边界和有效推断,这对部署在资源紧张的临床环境中的模型构成根本性挑战。 在本文中,我们提出GAD-MambaUNet,这是一个不对称的局部-全球分化网络,将轻量级演化模型与高效的状态-空间背景聚合结合起来。 我们的建筑采用浅层的轻量级演化块来感知局部特征,并在更深层引入方向-组图选择扫描块(DG-GSS),用于高效的远程建模. 在每个DG-GSS区块中,方向-组特征响应被作为图表节点处理,结构化消息传递在多方向聚变之前进行,实现交叉方向和跨子空间信息交互. 为了在不增加推论成本的情况下进一步加强语义表现,我们采用了一种被冻结的事先训练的DINOv3模型,仅在培训期间作为语义教师,通过Gradient-Adaptive Dispilation将其语义学前科转移到紧凑的学生网络. 对多个公共医疗图像分解基准的广泛实验表明,GAD-MambaUNet以有利的推论效率实现了优异的分解精度.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Accurate medical image segmentation is a cornerstone of computer-aided diagnosis, treatment planning, and quantitative disease assessment. Given a medical image, the objective is to assign a pixel-level label to each region of interest, with particular emphasis on preserving fine anatomical boundaries. This task is inherently challenging: lesions and organs often appear small, irregular, poorly contrasted, or visually similar to surrounding tissues. A robust segmentation model must therefore integrate fine-grained local evidence—essential for boundary delineation—with sufficient global contextual information to resolve foreground–background ambiguities.
blocks.zh: 准确的医学图像分割是计算机辅助诊断、治疗规划和定量疾病评估的基石。 鉴于医疗形象,目标是为每个感兴趣的区域指定一个像素级的标签,特别强调保留细解剖边界。 这项任务本身就具有挑战性:损伤和器官往往看起来很小、不规则、对比差,或与周围组织相类似。 因此,强有力的分块模式必须结合精细的当地证据——这是划定边界所必需的——与足够的全球背景信息,以解决地表背景模糊问题。

blocks.en: The U-Net architecture [ 15 ] established the dominant encoder–decoder paradigm, using a contracting path to extract hierarchical semantic features and symmetric skip connections to preserve spatial resolution for precise reconstruction. Subsequent CNN-based extensions have improved feature fusion, attention mechanisms, and multi-scale decoding [ 5 , 8 , 3 ] . Despite these advances, convolutional networks remain inherently constrained by local receptive fields, which limits their ability to model long-range dependencies—a critical capability when boundary interpretation relies on global lesion shape, continuity cues, or contextual information.
blocks.zh: U-Net架构 [15] 确立了占主导地位的编码器–解码器范式,使用订约路径提取层次语义特征和对称跳过连接,以保存空间分辨率,用于精确重建. 随后基于CNN的扩展改进了特性聚变,注意力机制,以及多尺度的解码[5,8,3]. 尽管取得了这些进展,但演变中的网络仍然受到当地接受领域的固有制约,这限制了它们建立长期依赖性模型的能力,而当边界解释依赖于全球损害形状、连续性提示或背景信息时,这种能力至关重要。

blocks.en: Transformer-based architectures, such as TransUNet [ 3 ] , address this limitation by introducing self-attention for global feature aggregation. This design substantially enlarges the receptive field and improves contextual reasoning. However, global attention and large-scale pretrained backbones come at a cost: increased parameter counts, higher memory consumption, and slower inference, which hinder deployment in resource-limited clinical or edge-device settings. As medical AI shifts from centralized laboratory analysis to point-of-care and edge applications, segmentation accuracy alone no longer suffices. Model efficiency—measured by parameter count, FLOPs, and inference latency—has become equally important.
blocks.zh: 基于变形器的架构,如TransUNet[3],通过引入全局特性聚合的自我关注来解决这一限制. 这一设计大大扩展了可接受领域,改善了背景推理。 然而,全球关注和大规模预先训练的骨干付出的代价是:参数计数增加,内存消耗增加,推论较慢,这阻碍了在资源有限的临床或边缘设备设置中的部署. 随着医疗AI从集中的实验室分析转向护理点和边缘应用,单是分解精度就不再足够了. 以参数计数、FLOPs和推断延迟为衡量效率的模型也变得同样重要。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Accuracy–efficiency comparison across PH 2 , ISIC2018, CVC-ClinicDB, and CVC-ColonDB. The vertical axis reports the macro-average Dice score over the four datasets, while the horizontal axes show student-side parameters and FLOPs. Compared with existing lightweight segmentation networks, GAD-MambaUNet achieves a more favorable Pareto balance between segmentation accuracy and deployment cost. The DINOv3 teacher is used only during training and is excluded from deployment cost.
blocks.zh: 图1:PH 2、ISIC-2018、CVC-ClinicDB和CVC-ColonDB的准确性效率比较。 垂直轴在四个数据集上报告宏平均值的Dice分数,而水平轴则显示学生侧参数和FLOP. 与现有的轻量级分区网络相比,GAD-MambaUNet在分区精度和部署成本之间实现了较为有利的Pareto平衡. DINOv3教师仅在培训期间使用,不包括部署费用。

blocks.en: This has motivated a series of lightweight segmentation networks based on depth-wise convolution [ 13 ] , compact channel designs [ 20 ] , and efficient token mixing [ 17 , 14 , 21 ] . Among emerging techniques, visual state-space models, particularly Mamba [ 6 ] and VMamba [ 10 ] , offer a compelling alternative: they achieve global receptive fields with linear sequence complexity, avoiding the quadratic cost of self-attention. VM-UNet [ 16 ] further incorporates visual state-space blocks into a U-shaped segmentation backbone.
blocks.zh: 这促使了一系列轻量级分解网络,其基础是深智演化[13],紧凑的通道设计[20],以及高效的符号混合[17,14,21]. 在新兴技术中,视觉状态空间模型,特别是Mamba[6]和VMamba[10],提供了一个令人信服的替代品:它们实现了具有线性序列复杂性的全球可接受域,避免了自觉的四重成本. VM-UNet [16] 进一步将视觉状态空间块纳入U形分区主干线.

blocks.en: To further reduce computational cost, grouped Mamba [ 24 ] partitions feature channels into parallel groups and performs multi-directional selective scanning across each group independently. While this strategy effectively lowers FLOPs, it introduces a fundamental limitation: different direction–group branches are processed in isolation and merged only after scanning. This independent design restricts the exchange of complementary contextual cues across scanning directions and channel subspaces, potentially weakening the model’s capacity to capture holistic scene understanding. To address this limitation, we propose Direction-Group Graph Selective Scan (DG-GSS), which models direction–group feature responses as graph nodes and enables structured message passing before multi-directional fusion, thereby facilitating cross-direction and cross-subspace interaction.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步降低计算成本,将Mamba[24]分区的通道分成平行分组,并对每个分组进行多方向选择性扫描。 虽然这一策略实际上降低了FLOP,但它引入了一个根本性的限制:不同的方向-分组分支是孤立处理的,只有在扫描后才会合并. 这种独立设计限制了跨扫描方向和通道子空间的互补背景提示的交流,有可能削弱模型获取整体场景理解的能力. 为了解决这一限制,我们提议方向-分组图选择扫描(DG-GSS),该扫描将方向-分组的响应作为图表节点进行模型化,并使结构化的信息在多方向聚变之前传递,从而促进交叉方向和跨子空间的相互作用.

blocks.en: Training lightweight segmentation models on limited medical datasets often leads to insufficient semantic abstraction. While larger vision foundation models, such as DINOv3 [ 18 ] , provide rich semantic priors, they are too heavy for deployment. Feature distillation offers a practical middle ground: a frozen teacher provides dense supervision during training, and is discarded at inference. However, a fixed distillation coefficient cannot adapt to the evolving optimization state of the student, potentially under- or over-regularizing the segmentation objective. To overcome this, we adapt Gradient-Adaptive Distillation (GAD), which dynamically adjusts the distillation strength based on the gradient contribution of the aligned decoder block, ensuring balanced semantic transfer without compromising the primary task.
blocks.zh: 在有限的医学数据集上培训轻量级分解模型往往导致语义抽象不足. 虽然更大的视觉基础模型,如DINOv3[18],提供了丰富的语义学前科,但它们太重无法部署. 特质蒸馏提供了实用的中间点:冷冻的教师在训练期间提供密集的监管,在推论中被抛弃. 然而,固定的蒸馏系数不能适应学生不断演变的优化状态,可能使分离目标不够规范或过于规范。 为了克服这一点,我们调整了渐变-加速分解(GAD),它根据对齐的解码器块的梯度贡献来动态调整分解强度,确保均衡的语义传动而不损害主要任务.

blocks.en: Based on the above analysis, we propose GAD-MambaUNet, an asymmetric local–global lightweight segmentation network for medical image segmentation. Our architecture employs lightweight convolutional blocks in shallow stages to retain fine-grained boundary details, and introduces DG-GSS blocks in deeper stages for efficient long-range features. Within each DG-GSS block, direction–group feature responses are treated as graph nodes, and structured message passing is performed prior to multi-directional fusion, enabling cross-direction and cross-subspace information interaction. We further incorporate a frozen pretrained DINOv3 model as a semantic teacher during training only, transferring its semantic priors to the compact student network via Gradient-Adaptive Distillation.
blocks.zh: 基于上述分析,我们提出GAD-MambaUNet,这是一个不对称的局部-全球轻量级分片网络,用于医疗图像分片。 我们的建筑采用浅层轻量级演化区块来保留精细的边界细节,并将DG-GSS区块引入更深层,用于高效的远程特征. 在每个DG-GSS区块中,方向-组特征响应被作为图表节点处理,结构化消息传递在多方向聚变之前进行,实现交叉方向和跨子空间信息交互. 我们还在培训期间将冻结的预先训练的DINOv3模型作为语义教师,通过Gradient-Adaptive Distillation将其语义学前科转移到紧凑的学生网络。

blocks.en: In summary, the main contributions of this work can be categorized into four aspects:
blocks.zh: 总之,这项工作的主要贡献可分为四个方面:

blocks.en: • We propose DG-GSS, a novel graph-enhanced selective scan mechanism that models direction–group feature responses as graph nodes and performs structured message passing before multi-directional fusion, improving contextual interaction without increasing inference cost. • We introduce Gradient-Adaptive Distillation, which dynamically regulates the distillation coefficient according to the gradient share of the aligned decoder block during training, and demonstrate its effectiveness in transferring DINOv3 semantic priors to a compact student without incurring inference overhead. • We design GAD-MambaUNet, an asymmetric local–global lightweight segmentation network that combines convolutional local modeling in shallow stages with DG-GSS-based long-range modeling in deep stages, achieving a favorable accuracy–efficiency balance. • We conduct extensive experiments on PH 2 , ISIC2018, CVC-ClinicDB, and CVC-ColonDB, showing that GAD-MambaUNet achieves a superior accuracy–efficiency balance in terms of Dice score, parameters, and FLOPs. As shown in Fig. 1 , the proposed models obtain more favorable performance, while DINOv3 supervision improves accuracy without increasing inference cost.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们提出DG-GSS,这是一种新的增强图形选择性扫描机制,它将方向模型化——分组将响应作为图表节点,并在多方向聚变之前执行结构化消息传递,在不增加推论成本的情况下改善背景互动。 我们引入了渐变-梯度分解(Gradient-Adaptive Distillation),它能根据训练期间对齐的解码器块的梯度比例动态地调节蒸馏系数,并证明它能有效地将DINOv3语义学前科转移给紧凑的学生,而不会引起推论的间接费用. ^ 我们设计了GAD-MambaUNet(GAD-MambaUNet),这是一个不对称的局部-全球轻量级分化网络,它将在浅层阶段的演化局部模型与基于DG-GSS的远程模型在深层阶段结合,实现有利的精度-效率平衡。 ^ 我们在PH 2、ISIC2018、CVC-ClinicDB和CVC-ColonDB上进行了广泛的实验,表明GAD-MambaUNet在Dice分数、参数和FLOP方面实现了更好的精度-效率平衡。 如图1所示,提议的模型获得更有利的性能,而DINOv3监督则在不增加推论成本的情况下提高准确性。

blocks.en: We propose DG-GSS, a novel graph-enhanced selective scan mechanism that models direction–group feature responses as graph nodes and performs structured message passing before multi-directional fusion, improving contextual interaction without increasing inference cost.
blocks.zh: 我们提出DG-GSS,这是一种新的增强图形的选择性扫描机制,将方向 - 分组的响应模型化为图表节点,并在多方向聚变之前执行结构化消息传递,改善背景互动而不会增加推论成本.

blocks.en: We introduce Gradient-Adaptive Distillation, which dynamically regulates the distillation coefficient according to the gradient share of the aligned decoder block during training, and demonstrate its effectiveness in transferring DINOv3 semantic priors to a compact student without incurring inference overhead.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了渐变(Gradient-Adaptive Distillation),它能根据训练期间对齐的解码器块的梯度比例,动态地调节蒸馏系数,并展示其将DINOv3语义学前科转移给紧凑的学生而不会引起推论间接费用的有效性.

blocks.en: We design GAD-MambaUNet, an asymmetric local–global lightweight segmentation network that combines convolutional local modeling in shallow stages with DG-GSS-based long-range modeling in deep stages, achieving a favorable accuracy–efficiency balance.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了GAD-MambaUNet(GAD-MambaUNet),这是一个不对称的局部-全球轻量级分化网络,它将在浅层阶段的演化局部模型与基于DG-GSS的远程模型在深层阶段结合,实现有利的精度-效率平衡.

blocks.en: We conduct extensive experiments on PH 2 , ISIC2018, CVC-ClinicDB, and CVC-ColonDB, showing that GAD-MambaUNet achieves a superior accuracy–efficiency balance in terms of Dice score, parameters, and FLOPs. As shown in Fig. 1 , the proposed models obtain more favorable performance, while DINOv3 supervision improves accuracy without increasing inference cost.
blocks.zh: 我们在PH 2、ISIC2018、CVC-ClinicDB和CVC-ColonDB上进行了广泛的实验,表明GAD-MambaUNet在Dice分数、参数和FLOP方面实现了更好的精度-效率平衡。 如图1所示,提议的模型获得更有利的性能,而DINOv3监督则在不增加推论成本的情况下提高准确性。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Medical Segmentation and Lightweight U-Shaped Networks
blocks.zh: 2.1 医疗分区和轻型U形网络

blocks.en: U-Net [ 15 ] and its encoder–decoder variants remain a primary template for medical image segmentation because skip connections combine deep semantic features with spatially precise reconstruction. This design is particularly suitable for medical segmentation, where the model must simultaneously capture high-level anatomical or lesion semantics and recover fine boundary details. Task-specific methods strengthen this template through mechanisms such as reverse attention in PraNet [ 5 ] and uncertainty-aware context attention in UACANet [ 8 ] . TransUNet [ 3 ] instead introduces a Transformer encoder to enlarge the receptive field through global self-attention. These approaches establish the value of contextual reasoning for resolving ambiguous foreground–background regions, but their attention modules or pretrained encoders can be costly when the deployment budget is limited.
blocks.zh: U-Net [15] 及其编码器–解码器变体仍然是医学图像分割的主要模板,因为跳过连接结合了深语义特征和空间精确重建. 这种设计特别适合医学分解,模型必须同时捕捉高级解剖或损伤语义,并恢复细细的边界细节. 针对具体任务的方法通过PRANet[5]的反向关注和UACANet[8]的不确定性认识背景关注等机制加强本模板. 转 UNet [3] 转而采用变形器编码器,通过全球自觉来扩大可接受领域。 这些办法确定了背景推理对于解决模糊的前缘-后缘区域的价值,但在部署预算有限时,其注意力模块或事先训练的编码器可能代价高昂。

blocks.en: Lightweight U-shaped networks reduce this cost through compact channel schedules and efficient local operators. UNeXt [ 21 ] combines convolution with shifted MLP blocks, CMUNeXt [ 20 ] uses large kernels and skip fusion, EGE-UNet [ 17 ] develops group-enhanced attention, and EMCAD [ 14 ] employs efficient multi-scale convolutional decoding. MK-UNet [ 13 ] further uses parallel multi-kernel depth-wise convolutions, channel shuffle, and lightweight decoder attention to capture multi-scale boundary evidence with compact cost. These lightweight CNN-based designs are effective for preserving local details and improving deployment efficiency. However, they still mainly rely on local or convolution-dominated operators and may lack explicit long-range contextual modeling when target boundaries are incomplete, lesion regions are ambiguous, or distant anatomical structures share similar textures. This limitation motivates the use of more efficient global modeling mechanisms in lightweight segmentation networks.
blocks.zh: 轻量级U形网络通过紧凑的信道时间表和高效的本地操作员来降低这一成本. UNeXt [21] 结合了转动的MLP块,CMUNEXt [20] 使用大内核并跳过聚变,EGE-UNet [17] 发展了群体增强的注意力,EMCAD [14] 采用了高效的多尺度的演化解码. MK-UNet [13] 进一步使用平行的多内核深智折射,通道洗涤,轻量级解码器注意,以紧凑的成本捕捉多尺度边界证据. 这些基于CNN的轻量级设计对于保存本地细节和提高部署效率是有效的. 然而,它们仍然主要依靠当地或革命为主的操作者,在目标边界不完整,损伤区模糊不清,或者遥远的解剖结构具有相似的纹理时,可能缺乏明确的长距离背景模型. 这一限制促使在轻量级分区网络中使用更有效的全球模型机制。

blocks.en: 2.2 Visual State-Space Models
blocks.zh: 2.2 视觉国家空间模型

blocks.en: State-space models offer an efficient alternative to self-attention for long-range feature modeling. Mamba [ 6 ] uses input-dependent state transitions with linear sequence complexity, while VMamba [ 10 ] extends selective scanning to visual feature maps through multiple two-dimensional traversal directions. By replacing quadratic global attention with selective scanning, visual state-space models provide a favorable trade-off between global context modeling and computational efficiency. VM-UNet [ 16 ] incorporates visual state-space blocks into a U-shaped segmentation architecture, showing the potential of state-space modeling for medical image segmentation.
blocks.zh: 国家空间模型为远程地物模型的自觉性提供了一个有效的替代办法。 Mamba [6]使用具有线性序列复杂性的输入依赖状态过渡,而VMamba [10]则通过多个二维转动方向将选择性扫描扩展至视觉特征地图. 通过以选择性扫描取代四极全球关注,视觉状态-空间模型为全球背景模型和计算效率提供了有利的权衡。 VM-UNet [16] 将视觉状态-空间块整合到U形的分区结构中,显示了状态-空间模型对医疗图像分区的潜力.

blocks.en: For lightweight medical segmentation, UltraLight VM-UNet [ 24 ] further reduces Vision Mamba cost by partitioning deep features into parallel channel groups and processing them with parallel Vision Mamba branches. This grouped design is attractive because global modeling is introduced only in a compact and computationally efficient form. However, in grouped multi-directional scans, direction–group branches are typically processed independently and merged only after selective scanning. Although this design reduces computation, it does not explicitly model the structural relationship between traversal directions and channel subspaces.
blocks.zh: 对于轻量级医疗分区,UltraLight VM-UNet[24]通过将深层特征分为平行通道组并用平行的Vision Mamba分支进行处理,进一步降低了Vision Mamba的成本. 这种分组设计很有吸引力,因为全球模型的采用方式只是紧凑和计算效率高。 然而,在分组多方向扫描中,方向-分组分支一般都是独立处理的,只有在选择性扫描后才能合并. 虽然这种设计减少了计算,但并没有明确地模拟曲面方向和通道子空间之间的结构关系.

blocks.en: As a result, complementary directional cues and group-wise semantic responses cannot be exchanged before fusion. Different traversal directions may capture different aspects of spatial context, while different channel groups may encode distinct but correlated semantic patterns. Processing them in isolation can therefore weaken the model’s ability to form a holistic contextual representation. This limitation motivates our Direction-Group Graph Selective Scan (DG-GSS), which introduces structured interaction among direction–group responses while preserving the efficiency of grouped selective scanning.
blocks.zh: 因此,在聚变之前,不能交换辅助方向提示和分组语义反应. 不同的转动方向可能捕捉空间背景的不同方面,而不同的通道组可能编码不同但相互关联的语义模式. 因此,孤立处理它们会削弱模型形成整体背景代表的能力。 这一限制激励了我们的方向-组图选择扫描(DG-GSS),它引入了方向-组响应之间的结构化交互,同时保持分组选择性扫描的效率.

blocks.en: 2.3 Foundation-Model Distillation for Lightweight Segmentation
blocks.zh: 2.3 轻量级分片基式蒸馏模型

blocks.en: Strong Transformer encoders and vision foundation models provide rich semantic representations for medical image segmentation. Swin Transformer [ 11 ] and its medical segmentation variant Swin-Unet [ 2 ] model hierarchical visual features, while DINOv3 [ 18 ] provides dense features through large-scale self-supervised pretraining. Such models can provide strong high-level semantic priors, which are useful for distinguishing ambiguous lesion regions from visually similar background tissues. However, directly deploying these large encoders conflicts with the parameter, memory, and latency budgets of lightweight systems.
blocks.zh: 强变形器编码器和视觉基础模型为医学图像分解提供了丰富的语义表现. Swin Transformer [11] 及其医疗分区变体 Swin-Unet [2] 模式等级视觉特征,而DINov3 [18] 通过大规模自我监督预训提供密集特征. 这种模型可以提供很强的高级语义学前科,有助于区分视力相似的背景组织中模棱两可的损伤区域. 然而,直接部署这些大型编码器与轻量级系统的参数,内存,和延迟预算相冲突.

blocks.en: Feature-level distillation offers a practical alternative: a frozen teacher provides dense supervision only during training, allowing a compact student to inherit semantic context without the teacher’s deployment cost [ 7 ] . This strategy is especially suitable for lightweight segmentation, where the student must remain efficient during inference but can still benefit from stronger semantic guidance during optimization. Most distillation settings use a fixed distillation coefficient. However, a fixed coefficient cannot adapt to the dynamic state of optimization: as training progresses, the gradient contribution of the teacher-supervised deep student feature to the overall network can change, so the same coefficient may yield insufficient teacher supervision or impose an overly strong constraint on the primary task objective.
blocks.zh: 特质级蒸馏提供了一个实用的替代方案:冷冻教师只在培训期间提供密集的监管,允许紧凑的学生在不负担教师部署费用的情况下继承语义背景[7]. 这一策略特别适合轻量级分解,在推论中学生必须保持效率,但在优化时仍可受益于更强的语义指导. 大多数蒸馏设置使用固定的蒸馏系数. 然而,固定系数不能适应最优化的动态状态:随着培训的进步,教师监督的深层学生特征对整体网络的梯度贡献可以改变,因此同样的系数可能导致教师监督不足,或对主要任务目标施加过度的制约.

blocks.en: To address this dynamic balancing problem, RT-DETRv4 [ 9 ] proposes a gradient-aware distillation strategy for real-time detection. In its reported configuration, a frozen DINOv3-ViT-B teacher supervises deep detector features through a Deep Semantic Injector, and Gradient-guided Adaptive Modulation adjusts the semantic-transfer strength using gradient norm ratios. Inspired by this strategy, our work adapts DINOv3-based gradient-adaptive distillation to lightweight medical image segmentation. Specifically, teacher features are aligned with a deep decoder representation of the student, and the distillation strength is dynamically regulated according to the gradient share of the aligned decoder block. During inference, the teacher and projection head are discarded, so the semantic supervision improves the compact student without increasing deployment cost.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一动态平衡问题,RT-DETRv4[9]提出了梯度感知的实时检测蒸馏策略. 在其报告的配置中,一个被冻结的DINOv3-ViT-B老师通过深语义注射器来监督深语义探测器的特性,渐变导调性运动则使用梯度规范比来调整语义转移强度. 受这一策略的启发,我们的工作将基于DINOv3的梯度适应蒸馏改造为轻量级医疗影像分化. 具体来说,师生特征与学生深解码代表一致,蒸馏强度根据对齐解码器块的梯度比例进行动态调节. 在推论期间,老师和投影头被丢弃,因此语义监督在不增加部署成本的情况下改善紧凑学生.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We describe the proposed GAD-MambaUNet by first introducing its core building block and then integrating it into an asymmetric U-shaped segmentation architecture.
As shown in Fig. 2 , the left part presents the overall student network and the training-time DINOv3 teacher, while the right part details the proposed block-level design and the internal structure of Direction-Group Graph Selective Scan (DG-GSS).
We first present DG-GSS, which enables structured interaction among scan directions and channel groups. Then, we describe how DG-GSS is embedded into the overall GAD-MambaUNet architecture. Finally, we introduce the training-time DINOv3 supervision with Gradient-Adaptive Distillation (GAD), where the teacher model is used only during training and removed during inference.

blocks.en: 3.3 Training-Time DINOv3 Supervision with GAD
blocks.zh: 3.3 与性别与发展司的监管

blocks.en: Although DG-GSS improves contextual modeling inside the compact student network, training a lightweight segmentation model on limited medical datasets may still lead to insufficient semantic abstraction. Inspired by the DINOv3-based gradient-adaptive distillation strategy in RT-DETRv4 [ 9 ] , we adapt training-time foundation-model supervision to lightweight medical image segmentation. A frozen pretrained DINOv3 model [ 18 ] is used as the semantic teacher only during training, and the teacher branch is removed during inference.
blocks.zh: 虽然DG-GSS改进了紧凑学生网络内部的背景模型,但在有限的医疗数据集上培训一个轻量级分解模型仍然可能导致语义抽象不足. 受RT-DETRv4 [9]中基于DINOv3的梯度适应蒸馏策略的启发,我们调整了训练时基建模型监督,使之适应轻量级医疗影像分化. 冷冻预训的DINOv3型号[18]仅在培训期间作为语义教师使用,教师分支在推论时被移除.

blocks.en: We adopt a capacity-matched teacher assignment strategy for different student scales. Specifically, DINOv3 ViT-T/16 is used for the Tiny, Small, and Base variants, while DINOv3 ViT-B/16 is used for the Medium and Large variants. For compact students, the smaller teacher provides moderate semantic guidance while avoiding an excessive teacher–student capacity gap and unnecessary training overhead. For larger students, the stronger ViT-B/16 teacher provides richer high-level semantic supervision, which can be better absorbed by higher-capacity decoder representations. Since the DINOv3 teacher is discarded during inference, this assignment affects only the training-time supervision strength and does not change the student-side deployment cost.
blocks.zh: 我们针对不同的学生规模,采取了与能力相称的教师分配战略。 具体来说,DINov3 VIT-T/16被用于小y,小 variant和基 variant变种,而DINov3 VIT-B/16用于中 Large和大 variant变种. 对于紧凑的学生来说,较小的教师提供温和的语义指导,同时避免师生能力差距过大和不必要的培训费。 对于较大的学生来说,更强大的VIT-B/16老师提供了更丰富的高级语义监督,这可以更好地被更高的容量的解码代表物吸收. 由于DINOv3教师在推论期间被抛弃,这一任务只影响培训时间监督力量,并不改变学生方的部署费用.

blocks.en: As described in the previous subsection, the student feature used for distillation is extracted after the first decoder block and before the first upsampling operation. This feature is semantically rich, spatially compact, and computationally inexpensive for feature alignment. blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets and Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集和计量

blocks.en: We evaluate GAD-MambaUNet on four public binary medical image segmentation datasets covering two representative segmentation tasks. For skin lesion segmentation, we use PH 2 [ 12 ] , which contains 200 dermoscopic images with expert lesion annotations, and ISIC2018 [ 4 ] , which contains 2,594 dermoscopic images with pixel-level lesion masks. For polyp segmentation, we use CVC-ClinicDB [ 1 ] , which contains 612 colonoscopic polyp images, and CVC-ColonDB [ 19 , 22 ] , which contains 379 colonoscopic images collected from different video sequences. These datasets include diverse imaging conditions, lesion appearances, object scales, boundary ambiguities, and foreground–background contrasts, providing a comprehensive evaluation of the robustness of lightweight segmentation models.
blocks.zh: 我们评价GAD-曼巴 UNet上4个公共二元医学影像分解数据集,涵盖两个代表性分解任务. 对于皮肤损伤分解,我们使用含有200张带有专家损伤说明的皮肤图像的PH 2 [12] 和含有2 594张带有像素级损伤口罩的皮肤图像的ISIC 2018 [4]。 对于多肽分解,我们使用CVC-ClinicDB [1],其中包含612个对角多肽图像,CVC-ColonDB [19,22],其中包含从不同视频序列收集的379个对角图像. 这些数据集包括不同的成像条件,损伤外观,物体尺度,边界模糊度,以及前景-背景对比,为轻量级分解模型的稳健性提供了全面的评价.

blocks.en: We split each dataset into training, validation, and test subsets with a ratio of 80:10:10. The validation set is used for model selection, and the test set is used for final performance reporting. Dice score is used as the primary segmentation metric, and Intersection over Union (IoU) is also reported when applicable. To evaluate model efficiency, we report the number of trainable parameters and floating-point operations (FLOPs). Since the DINOv3 teacher is used only during training and is discarded during deployment, it does not introduce additional inference computation. Therefore, all efficiency metrics are computed using the student network alone.
blocks.zh: 我们把每个数据集分成训练、验证和测试子集,比例为80:10:10。 验证集用于模型选择,测试集用于最终业绩报告. Dice分数作为主要分数的衡量标准,在适用时还报告跨联盟(IoU)交叉分数。 为了评价模型效率,我们报告可训练参数和浮点操作(FLOPs)的数量. 由于DINOv3教师仅在培训期间使用,在部署期间被丢弃,因此它没有引入额外的推论计算. 因此,所有效率衡量标准都仅用学生网络计算。

blocks.en: 4.2 Implementation Protocol
blocks.zh: 4.2 执行议定书

blocks.en: All experiments are implemented in PyTorch and conducted under the same training and evaluation settings for fair comparison. Following the input-resolution settings adopted in MK-UNet, images from PH 2 and ISIC2018 are resized to 256 × 256 256\times 256 , while images from CVC-ClinicDB and CVC-ColonDB are resized to 352 × 352 352\times 352 . The validation set is used for checkpoint selection, and the corresponding test performance is reported.
blocks.zh: 所有试验都在PyTorch进行,并在同样的培训和评价环境中进行,以便进行公平的比较。 根据MK-UNet采用的输入分辨率设置,PH 2和ISIC2018的图像大小调整为256×256256\times 256,而CVC-ClinicDB和CVC-CoronDB的图像大小调整为352×352352\times 352... 验证集用于检查点选择,并报告相应的测试性能.

blocks.en: For GAD-MambaUNet, we use AdamW as the optimizer with an initial learning rate of 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} , a weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and cosine learning-rate decay to 10 − 6 10^{-6} . All models are trained for 400 epochs with a batch size of 8, gradient clipping at 0.5, and standard data augmentation. The segmentation objective is the sum of weighted binary cross-entropy and weighted IoU losses. Unless otherwise specified, each configuration is repeated over five independent runs, and the mean test performance is reported.
blocks.zh: 为GAD-曼巴 UNet,我们使用AdamW作为优化器,初始学习率为5×10−4 5\times 10×4},体重衰减为10−4 10×4},余弦学习率衰减为10−6 10×6}. 所有模型都为400个纪元训练,批量尺寸为8,梯度剪切0.5,标准数据增强. 分化目标是加权二进制横切和加权IoU损失的总和. 除非另有说明,每个配置在五个独立的运行中重复,并报告平均测试性能.

blocks.en: For training-time semantic supervision, we use frozen DINOv3 ViT-T/16 and ViT-B/16 models as semantic teachers in different experimental settings. The student feature after the first decoder block is aligned to the teacher feature through the projection head described in Section 3 . DINOv3 distillation starts at epoch 10 and is linearly warmed up for 20 epochs. GAD is activated at epoch 30 and adaptively controls the distillation coefficient until epoch 360. During inference, the teacher branch, projection head, and GAD update are discarded, so the reported parameters and FLOPs are computed using only the student network.
blocks.zh: 对于培训时间语义学监督,我们使用冷冻的DINOv3 VIT-T/16和VIT-B/16模型作为不同实验环境下的语义学教师. 第一个解码器块后的学生特征通过第3节描述的投影头与老师特征对齐. DINOv3蒸馏从10号时间开始,线性加热20个时间段. GAD在30世纪启动,并适应性地控制蒸馏系数直到360世纪. 在推论中,师资分支,投影头和GAD更新被丢弃,因此所报告的参数和FLOP只使用学生网络计算.

blocks.en: 4.3 Comparison with Reference Methods
blocks.zh: 4.3 与参考方法的比较

blocks.en: Tab. 1 compares GAD-MambaUNet with representative medical image segmentation networks and lightweight baselines on four public datasets. Compared with heavy encoder–decoder and Transformer-based models, the proposed models achieve competitive or better accuracy with substantially lower complexity. As shown in Tab. 1 , TransUNet requires 105.32M parameters and 38.52G FLOPs with an average Dice of 91.70%, whereas GAD-MambaUNet-B without DINOv3 achieves a higher average Dice of 92.27% using only 0.493M parameters and 0.322G FLOPs. This indicates that the proposed asymmetric local–global design can improve segmentation accuracy without relying on a heavy backbone.
blocks.zh: 标签 1 比较 GAD- Mamba 在四个公共数据集上装有具有代表性的医疗图像分块网络和轻量基线的UNet。 与重编码器-解码器和变形器基模型相比,拟议的模型以低得多的复杂性实现竞争性或更好的精度. 如塔布所示. 1, 转 UNet需要105.32M参数和38.52G FLOP,平均剂量为91.70%,而没有DINOv3的GAD-MambaUNet-B平均剂量为92.27%,只使用0.493M参数和0.322G FLOP. 这表明,拟议的非对称的局部-全球设计可以提高分区精度,而无需依赖沉重的主干。

blocks.en: Among lightweight methods, MK-UNet is a strong reference baseline because it achieves competitive results with compact multi-kernel convolutional blocks. Compared with MK-UNet, which obtains an average Dice of 91.66% with 0.316M parameters and 0.314G FLOPs, GAD-MambaUNet-B without DINOv3 improves the average Dice to 92.27% with comparable computational cost. This gain is mainly attributed to introducing DG-GSS blocks only at deep low-resolution stages, thereby enhancing contextual modeling while keeping the inference cost low. Specifically, GAD-MambaUNet-B obtains 94.90%, 88.91%, 94.04%, and 91.24% Dice on PH 2 , ISIC2018, CVC-ClinicDB, and CVC-ColonDB, respectively. Increasing the model scale further improves the ClinicDB result, with GAD-MambaUNet-Large achieving 94.70% on CVC-ClinicDB and 91.37% on CVC-ColonDB.
blocks.zh: 在轻量级方法中,MK-UNet是一个很强的参考基准,因为它用紧凑的多内核演化块实现竞争结果. 与MK-UNet相比,GAD-Mamba平均得分91.66%,参数为0.316M和0.314G FLOPs 没有DINOv3的UNet-B将平均Dice提高到92.27%,计算成本相当。 这一增益主要归因于只在深度低分辨率阶段引入DG-GSS区块,从而增强背景模型,同时保持推论成本低. 具体来说,GAD-Mamba UNet-B在PH 2、ISIC2018、CVC-ClinicDB和CVC-CoronDB上分别获得94.90%、88.91%、94.04%和91.24%的Dice。 扩大模型规模进一步改善了ClinicDB的结果,GAD-MambaUNet-Large在CVC-ClinicDB上达到94.70%,在CVC-CoronDB上达到91.37%.

blocks.en: Training-time DINOv3 supervision consistently improves the student models without changing their student-side inference complexity. For example, GAD-MambaUNet-Base improves from 94.90% to 95.1% on PH 2 , from 88.91% to 89.06% on ISIC2018, from 94.04% to 94.17% on CVC-ClinicDB, and from 91.24% to 91.96% on CVC-ColonDB. The improvement is more evident on the challenging CVC-ColonDB dataset, where stronger semantic guidance helps distinguish polyp regions from visually similar background tissues. The Medium variant with DINOv3 obtains the best ColonDB Dice of 93.08%, while the Large variant with DINOv3 achieves the best PH 2 , ISIC2018, and CVC-ClinicDB results among the compared variants.
blocks.zh: 培训时间DINov3监督不断改进学生模式,而不改变学生侧推论的复杂性。 例如,GAD-MambaUNet-Base从94.90%提高到95.1%的PH 2,从88.91%提高到89.06%的ISIC-2018,从94.04%提高到94.17%的CVC-ClinicDB,从91.24%提高到91.96%的CVC-ColonDB。 这一改进在具有挑战性的CVC-CoronDB数据集上更为明显,其中较强的语义指导有助于区分多肽区域与视觉上相似的背景组织. 带有DINOv3的中位变体获得93.08%的ColonDB最佳配位,而带有DINOv3的大位变体获得PH 2,ISIC2018的最佳配位,CVC-ClinicDB在比较变体中的结果.

blocks.en: Overall, the results show that DG-GSS improves the accuracy–efficiency balance of the lightweight student, and DINOv3-GAD further enhances semantic representation during training without increasing deployment cost. This supports the motivation of combining deep direction–group state-space interaction with training-time foundation-model supervision for lightweight medical image segmentation.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,结果显示,DG-GSS提高了轻量级学生的准确率-效率平衡,而DINOv3-GAD则在不增加部署成本的情况下进一步提高了培训期间的语义表现。 这支持了将深方向-群体状态-空间互动与训练-时间基础模型监督相结合的动力,以进行轻量级医疗图像分割。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study of DG-GSS
blocks.zh: 4.4 DG-GSS的研究

blocks.en: To verify the effectiveness of the proposed Direction-Group Graph Selective Scan, we conduct an ablation study by comparing three representative variants, as shown in Tab. 2 . The MKIR baseline [ 13 ] corresponds to the lightweight convolutional design of MK-UNet, which mainly relies on local multi-kernel feature extraction. The GroupedSS2D variant replaces part of the deep local blocks with grouped multi-directional selective scanning, while the complete DG-GSS variant further introduces direction–group graph interaction among scan-direction and channel-group responses.
blocks.zh: 为了验证拟议的方向-分组图选择扫描的有效性,我们通过比较三个具有代表性的变体进行了一项消化研究,如Tab所示。 2,MKIR基线[13]对应MK-UNet的轻量级演化设计,主要依靠局部多内核特征提取. GroupedSS2D变体用分组多方向选择性扫描取代部分深方块,而完整的DG-GSS变体则进一步引入了扫描-方向和频道-分组响应之间的方向-组图交互.

blocks.en: Compared with the MKIR baseline, introducing GroupedSS2D improves the Dice score from 94.39% to 94.47% on PH 2 , from 88.74% to 88.79% on ISIC2018, from 93.48% to 93.76% on CVC-ClinicDB, and from 90.01% to 90.64% on CVC-ColonDB. This indicates that replacing deep local convolutional blocks with grouped selective scanning can enhance long-range contextual modeling while maintaining low computational cost.
blocks.zh: 与MKIR基线相比,采用GroupedSS2D提高了Dice的得分,PH2从94.39%提高到94.47%,ISIC2018从88.74%提高到88.79%,CVC-ClinicDB从93.48%提高到93.76%,CVC-ColonDB从90.01%提高到90.64%。 这表明,用分组选择性扫描取代深层局部演化区块可以加强远程背景模型,同时保持较低的计算成本.

blocks.en: The complete DG-GSS variant further improves over GroupedSS2D on all four datasets, achieving 94.90%, 88.91%, 94.04%, and 91.24% Dice on PH 2 , ISIC2018, CVC-ClinicDB, and CVC-ColonDB, respectively. The improvement is especially clear on CVC-ColonDB, where DG-GSS improves the Dice score by 0.60% over GroupedSS2D and by 1.23% over the MKIR baseline. This suggests that graph-based interaction among direction–group responses helps capture complementary contextual cues across scan directions and channel subspaces.
blocks.zh: 完整的DG-GSS变式在所有四个数据集上都进一步提高了GroupedSS2D,分别达到94.90%,88.91%,94.04%和91.24%的PH 2,ISIC2018,CVC-ClinicDB和CVC-ColonDB. 在CVC-ColonDB上,这一改进特别明显,DG-GSS比GroupedSS2D提高Dice分数0.6%,比MKIR基线提高1.23%. 这表明方向-分组反应之间的基于图表的互动有助于获取跨扫描方向和通道子空间的互补背景提示。

blocks.en: In terms of efficiency, DG-GSS keeps the computation lightweight by applying state-space modeling only at low-resolution deep stages. Although the parameter count differs across variants, all models remain within the lightweight range, and DG-GSS achieves the best overall segmentation performance with only 0.493M parameters and 0.322G FLOPs. These results show that the proposed DG-GSS module improves the accuracy–efficiency balance of the student network rather than simply relying on a heavier architecture.
blocks.zh: 在效率方面,DG-GSS通过只在低分辨率深层阶段应用状态空间模型来保持计算轻量级. 尽管参数计数因变种而异,但所有模型都保持在轻量级范围内,而DG-GSS仅以0.493M参数和0.322G FLOP实现最佳的整体分区性能. 这些结果表明,拟议的DG-GSS模块改进了学生网络的准确性-效率平衡,而不是简单地依赖更重的架构。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we proposed GAD-MambaUNet, a lightweight medical image segmentation network that combines efficient local modeling, direction–group state-space interaction, and training-time foundation-model supervision. To improve contextual modeling in compact segmentation networks, we introduced Direction-Group Graph Selective Scan (DG-GSS), which treated scan-direction and channel-group responses as graph nodes and enabled structured information exchange before multi-directional fusion. We further incorporated DINOv3-GAD supervision, where a frozen DINOv3 teacher provided semantic guidance during training, and Gradient-Adaptive Distillation dynamically regulated the distillation strength. GAD-MambaUNet achieves a favorable accuracy–efficiency balance compared with representative lightweight and general segmentation methods. Ablation studies further verify the effectiveness of DG-GSS and training-time DINOv3-GAD supervision. In future work, we will explore more flexible teacher–student alignment strategies and extend the proposed framework to more diverse medical segmentation scenarios, such as multi-class and multi-modal segmentation tasks.
